workflow_plan.goal: Create a census-tract choropleth of median gross rent in Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve Centre County median-rent attribute table
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a tabular candidate containing median gross rent values for Centre County census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a CSV attribute-table candidate for Centre County census tracts containing median gross rent data. workflow_steps.title: Join median rent attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the retrieved median gross rent attribute to the supplied Centre County tract geometries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the supplied tract vector and retrieved attribute table. Leave vector_key and table_key unset; runtime QC must ground compatible join fields from the observed schemas. Preserve the tract geometries and attach the field representing median gross rent. Leave the mapped field name unset for downstream runtime grounding.

workflow_steps.title: Create median gross rent choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Generate the requested census-tract choropleth for median gross rent in Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Create an HTML choropleth from the joined tract layer. Leave field unset; runtime QC must ground the observed attribute field representing median gross rent. Use the tract polygons as the mapped spatial unit and embed source and CRS verification metadata.
